name: diana-demo
description: DIANA — demo end-to-end: conversa monitorada -> análise de risco -> alerta estruturado ao responsável.

scripts.build: npm run build:libs && npm run build -w @diana/guardian-web
scripts.demo: npm run build:libs && npm run seed && STATE_DIR="$PWD/demo-state" ALERTS_SOURCE=file concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run start -w @diana/guardian-api" "npm run dev -w @diana/guardian-web"
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test
